messages:

Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@albatrosshealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity bump)

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off our renewal cycle for the Redwood contract and evaluating a capacity increase for Q1. Our platform team is projecting ~2x peak token consumption compared to our current commit and procurement has asked for a clear onboarding refresh for vendor data in our portal before PO and payment.

Could you send a short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines the procurement portal steps, required artifacts, and an example PO line item for 2x capacity? Also we need to confirm whether a 12-month term with committed capacity is available and any pricing delta.

Attached is our vendor info form for vendor onboarding. Appreciate a response this week if possible — procurement hopes to lock budget by 12/15.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Delgado
Head of Procurement
Albatross Health
attachments: Albatross_Vendor_Form.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Delgado <marta.delgado@albatrosshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity bump)

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the vendor form. Looping in Ben (Sales Ops) and Laura (Finance) to cover quote/PO guidance.

High-level MAP (proposed timeline):
1) Procurement artifacts (this week) — Redwood provides updated SOW, renewal MAP spreadsheet, and sample PO line items. Please confirm billing contact and PO template.
2) Vendor onboarding refresh (portal) — procurement uploads vendor form + SOC2 cert to your procurement portal; Redwood provides vendor ID and portal CSV template.
3) Legal/terms (3–5 business days) — if the customer accepts a 12-month committed term, Legal will prepare a short amendment (term + committed units).
4) PO issuance & invoicing — once PO is received, Finance issues invoice per agreed payment terms.
5) Provisioning & migration (1–2 weeks) — CS schedules capacity increase, we enable the additional GPU reservation.

Required artifacts we’ll provide: updated SOW (scope + committed capacity), Renewal_MAP_v2.xlsx (tasks + owners + timeline), sample PO line item. From your side: completed vendor form, PO template, and billing contact.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and the MAP spreadsheet. Ben — can you produce a renewal quote for 2x capacity on a 12-month committed term and include a sample PO line? Laura — any special billing notes we should flag for Albatross?

DocuSign: I’ll prepare the amendment and send a DocuSign link once we agree on price. HubSpot: I logged the renewal under company record ALB-2027.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0193
attachments: Albatross_SOW_v3.pdf, Renewal_MAP_v2.xlsx
From: Marta Delgado <marta.delgado@albatrosshealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@albatrosshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal (capacity bump)

Thanks Vanessa — that layout is helpful. A few clarifying items from procurement and platform: 
- Can you confirm turnaround time between PO receipt and capacity being live? We need it within 10 business days after PO if possible.
- We prefer a 12-month committed term with quarterly invoicing. Is there a standard discount for a committed 12-month renewal at 2x capacity?
- For the portal: does Redwood support bulk CSV upload for vendor documents (we have a handful of vendors to refresh)? If so please include the template.

I’ve attached our internal vendor form for legal review. If you can provide a sample PO line and an estimated renewal quote we can present to our budget owners on 12/15. If pricing needs more time, can you at least supply a not-to-exceed number today?

Appreciate the fast turnaround — our procurement team is on a tight cadence.

Regards,
Marta
attachments: Albatross_Vendor_Form.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Delgado <marta.delgado@albatrosshealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Procurement portal onboarding + capacity increase (renewal MAP)

Marta — forwarding final materials from Redwood. Apologies for the short delay; Laura and I finalized the numbers and sample PO.

Key points: 
- Renewal term options: 12-month committed (recommended) OR 24-month committed (additional 3% discount).
- 2x capacity quote (12-month committed): $198,000/yr (quarterly invoicing), which is a 12% uplift vs your current ARR for the existing commit.
- Lead time: 7 business days from receipt of a clean PO + completed vendor onboarding in your portal to capacity activation (we’ll prioritize for 12/15 budget lock).

Sample PO line (for your procurement template):
Redwood Inference — LLM Inference Commitment (12 mo) — 2x capacity — $49,500 — Quarterly invoice — SKU: RWI-2X-12M

Attachments included: Renewal_Quote_2x_capacity.pdf (official quote) and a PO CSV template for portal bulk upload. We also attached the final SOW with the committed capacity called out.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Procurement uploads completed vendor form + SOC2 to portal using the attached CSV template (we will validate once you notify us).
2) Procurement issues a PO referencing SKU RWI-2X-12M.
3) We send the amendment via DocuSign (expect this evening).
4) Dylan (CC’d) will follow up to schedule the provisioning window (target provisioning week 12/20).

If you need a short conference with finance to expedite the PO wording, I can jump on a 15-minute call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0110
attachments: Renewal_Quote_2x_capacity.pdf, PO_CSV_Template.csv
